metadata.note: Split form of the ThinkPad P14s Gen 2 (AMD) config. Every /etc file lives in etc/ as a real file (etc_tree), not as an escaped JSON string; the rest of the config is assembled with $include. Secrets live in secrets/ (gitignored): copy the .example files and fill them in — the LUKS passphrase is referenced by BOTH partitions from one file, so they cannot drift apart. Equivalent to laptop-p14s.json, plus config-saver.

notes: Lenovo ThinkPad P14s Gen 2 (AMD Ryzen 7 PRO 5850U, Cezanne iGPU, no discrete GPU). BEFORE APPLYING: (1) set both luks_password fields (they are placeholders — use the SAME passphrase on cryptroot and cryptswap so systemd's initrd password cache asks only once); (2) confirm the disk is /dev/nvme0n1 with lsblk — wipe_disk is true; (3) size the swap partition to your RAM (32GiB assumed) or hibernation cannot fit; (4) regenerate hashed_password with `dasik hash-password`. In the UEFI set Sleep to 'Linux' (s2idle) — with 'Windows 10' the lid switch is flaky. Fingerprint: Synaptics 06cb:00bd, supported in-tree; enrol with `fprintd-enroll` and keep the reader firmware current via fwupd.
